Governmental lines from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (trimmed p6-7), Total Governmental Funds column. ending_cash = Total Governmental Funds Balance Sheet cash and cash equivalents 4,493,507 (p5; cash with county treasurer 184,784 and restricted cash 2,587,423 printed on separate lines, not included). Business-type lines from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, Proprietary Funds, Total Enterprise Funds column (p11); internal service fund excluded. Printed no single total for business-type: receipts = operating revenues 26,065,563 + interest income 138,634 + grant revenue 123,000; disbursements = operating expenses 23,134,535 + interest expense 57,167. Business-type net transfers (561,585) agree to governmental transfers net +561,585 on p7. Governmental reconcile: 6,150,129 - 947,101 + 561,585 = 5,764,613. Balance sheet uses government-wide Primary Government Total column (includes internal service fund; business-type net position 35,639,206 there vs 34,960,169 for enterprise funds only; internal balances blank in total column). Deferred inflows (unavailable revenue - leases) recorded in deferred_inflows as Deferred Inflows for Leases. Compensated absences, landfill post-closure and lease liability lines are printed without the ' - Due ...' form, so they keep their accrued/other/debt categories. Proprietary cash flow investing net line is not on trimmed pages (page cut between pp12-13); investing = interest received 138,634, which reconciles to net increase 1,275,818. The p14 All-Purpose Fund budgetary comparison schedule (combines governmental and business-type funds) is not recorded in detail. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p6-7, p11).
